title: Design System: Silicon Valley AI Ecosystem Village

display.purpose: The marquee h1 only: white Press Start 2P with the sky-blue tube glow, capped at 24ch.

headline.purpose: On-canvas 16px pixel face: clock, counters, hub neon signs, PAUSED. 2x the font's native 8px grid.

title.purpose: Deal totals in the ledger footer.

label.purpose: Cabinet buttons, section headings, hub names in the ledger.

label-small.purpose: 8px uppercase HUD captions on canvas (IN TRANSIT, DEALS). Native pixel size; never 9 to 11px.

body.purpose: Everything read as a sentence: page body, ledger cells, log rows, canvas bubbles and inspector lines. 19px under 760px.

body-small.purpose: Hub produces lines and the keyboard hint.

caption.purpose: Table headers, kbd keys, the synthetic-data note.

shadows.name: bezel-bands
shadows.purpose: The screen frame only: two flat concentric bands and one deep drop under the cabinet screen. Under 760px: 0 0 0 3px #2c2f5c, 0 0 0 6px #0a0b19, 0 18px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.9).

shadows.name: marquee-tube
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on the marquee h1 only; the neon tube in the cabinet vocabulary. Breathes to 14px/36px at the midpoint of the 6s tube cycle.

shadows.name: canvas-neon-halo
shadows.value: shadowBlur: 8 + 16 * level * (0.4 + 0.6 * night), shadowColor: hub neon
shadows.purpose: Canvas-only halo behind a lit hub sign. No other canvas text uses shadowBlur.

motion.name: button-travel
motion.value: transform .08s ease-out, border-bottom-width .08s ease-out, background .15s ease-out
motion.purpose: Cabinet button press: 3px translateY and the 5px lower edge shrinking to 2px.

motion.name: log-row-enter
motion.value: enter .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); from { opacity: .2; transform: translateY(-6px) }
motion.purpose: The newest network-log row only. The sole content-entry animation in the HTML chrome; no section fades.

motion.name: marquee-tube-breath
motion.purpose: Marquee text-shadow breathing between the rest and peak glow. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: scanlines-fade
motion.purpose: Opt-in scanline overlay fading in when the Scanlines toggle is pressed. Off by default.

motion.name: neon-ignition
motion.value: thresholds night > 0.55 / 0.60 / 0.65 per hub; 1.2s stutter at hash-driven 1 or 0.12 level; then 0.94 + 0.06 sin(1.7t) breathing; off when night < 0.35
motion.purpose: The dusk signature: hub signs ignite one by one, flicker, then hold until dawn. Pulse is permitted on neon only.

motion.name: day-cycle
motion.value: DAY_LENGTH 150s; daylight = clamp((0.5 - 0.5 cos(2*pi*phase) - 0.15) / 0.6, 0, 1); night wash rgba(10,12,48, night * 0.62)
motion.purpose: Flat night, flat day, soft dusk. Hold night pins phase to 0.95.

motion.name: packet-bob
motion.value: y offset round(sin(4t + seed) * 1.2) world px; pulse ring (t % 2.2) / 2.2 at the plaza core
motion.purpose: Carried packets bob; the core router emits a fading ring every 2.2s. World motion, not UI motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .marquee h1 { animation: none } .ticker li:first-child { animation: none } .controls button { transition: none } }
motion.purpose: Every HTML animation and transition is removed; the canvas simulation itself continues.

breakpoints.name: deck-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: single-column control deck, 19px body, tighter bezel bands, Produces column hidden.

breakpoints.name: overlay-double
breakpoints.purpose: Rendered canvas width below which the overlay multiplier ui becomes 2: windows, fonts and insets double; economy window moves to bottom-right.

canvas.icons: 7x7 bitmap glyphs (house, pin, chart, sun, moon) drawn in code at 3px per cell on the overlay

detectorExceptions.reason: Deliberate: the brief pins neon signage; the marquee glow is the cabinet marquee tube. Recorded in .impeccable/config.json ignoreValues.
Deliberate: opt-in CRT scanlines behind a toggle, opacity 0 by default.

narrative.overview:
One village, one economy, watched through an arcade cabinet at dusk. The page is a cabinet: a deep indigo body, a flat-banded bezel, and a 4:3 CRT inside it where a saturated 32-bit village runs on its own. Everything outside the screen recedes into cabinet furniture (marquee, control deck, ledger, log) so the living artifact leads. The world renders at 400x300 and is blown up 2x with smoothing off, so every world pixel is a crisp 2x2 block; the overlay layer (signs, status windows, bubbles) draws at full resolution on even pixel coordinates so its grid never fights the world's.

The neon signs are the hero. A 150-second day cycle exists so that dusk can arrive, ambient light fall, and the three hub signs ignite one after another with a short stutter before settling into a slow breathing glow. Day is a lush pastoral; night is lanterns, window light, and three neon names over a dimmed village. The interface never competes with that moment: pulse belongs to neon only, the HTML chrome never fades sections, and the one motion it owns is a new log row sliding into place.

Density is readable, not busy. The HTML deck uses a bitmap pixel face for anything that names or labels, and a tall terminal face for anything you read in sentences; both are monospaced, so numbers line up without effort. There are no rounded corners anywhere, no gradients on components, no icon glyph fonts: every icon is a 7x7 bitmap drawn in code.
keyCharacteristics: Cabinet-around-CRT composition: indigo body, flat 4px/8px bezel bands, square corners throughout.
Three brand neons (sky blue, mint, violet) carry identity on canvas and in HTML alike; amber is the only non-brand accent and means "state" (pressed, selected, deals, paused).
Press Start 2P for every name and label; VT323 for every sentence; nothing else.
JRPG status windows (navy fill, 2px light border, 2px highlight line) for every in-canvas readout and bubble.
Motion is scarce and diegetic: neon ignition and breathing, bobbing packets, a 350ms log-row entry. No section fades, no parallax, no hover lifts.

rules.name: The Three Neons Rule
rules.body: Only the three hub colors and amber may glow, pulse, or cast light. Everything else in the palette is flat and matte, including the cabinet, the bezel, and every HTML control.

rules.name: The Amber Means State Rule
rules.body: Amber is never a brand and never decoration. If something is amber, it is pressed, selected, paused, focused, or a closed deal.

rules.name: The Family Reads Upward Rule
rules.body: For each hub, wall is darkest, roof brighter, trim pale, neon brightest. A new hub-colored element picks from that family and keeps that order.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P names and labels; VT323 reads. No third face, no bold, no italic. A new label is 8, 12, 14 or 16px pixel face; a new sentence is 17, 18 or 20px terminal face.

rules.name: The Pixel Grid Rule
rules.body: On canvas, the pixel face is drawn only at 8px or 16px (times the ui multiplier) and windows snap to even coordinates, so the font's grid lands on whole 2x2 world pixels.

rules.name: The Flat Cabinet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat bands and recessed wells. Nothing lifts on hover, nothing floats; depth is cut, not cast.

rules.name: The Glow Is Neon Rule
rules.body: A glow or blur belongs to a neon tube or a light source in the world. HTML controls, tables and windows never glow.

dos: Do keep every corner square; border-radius: 0 is the system.
Do color by hub: any element that belongs to BidDeed.AI, zonewise.ai or winnerdataai.com takes that hub's neon, and the hub's wall/roof/trim family for solid fills.
Do use amber only to mean a state: pressed, selected, focused, paused, or a closed deal.
Do draw new on-canvas readouts with windowBox (navy fill, 2px border, 2px highlight) and snap them to even pixels.
Do set the pixel face at 8, 12, 14 or 16px and the terminal face at 17, 18 or 20px; no sizes between.
Do make a new control a cabinet button: 2px border, 5px lower edge at rest, 3px travel when pressed, 80ms ease-out.
Do keep icons as 7x7 bitmaps drawn in code.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by removing the tube breath, the log-row entry and button transitions.
donts: Don't glow, blur or pulse anything that is not a neon sign or a light source in the world.
Don't fade sections, lift cards on hover, or add parallax; the only HTML motion is the log row entering and the button travelling.
Don't introduce a third typeface, a bold weight, or an italic.
Don't use gradients on components; the one gradient is the page background from cabinet-2 to cabinet.
Don't add icon fonts, SVG icon packs or emoji; the world's own bitmap glyphs are the icon set.
Don't turn the scanlines on by default; they are an opt-in toggle.
Don't put a drop shadow on anything but the screen bezel.
